status_policy.validated: The implementation, interface, fixtures, tests, and platform evidence satisfy the published acceptance gate.
status_policy.implemented: The capability is present and tested, but one or more parity, native-platform, or scientific validation gates remain open.
status_policy.prototype: An executable path exists, but its scientific depth, workflow completeness, or evidence is not release-validating.
status_policy.scaffolded: Contracts, manifests, or test structure exist without a complete user workflow.
status_policy.conditional-hardware: Completion requires named hardware, a licensed SDK, and hardware-in-loop evidence.
status_policy.reference-only: The item is a comparison source and is not an implemented FluxForge capability.
status_policy.not-applicable: This delivery layer is intentionally not applicable to the capability.

entries.title: Identification, activity, and reference parity
entries.notes: Library registration and activity review exist; full relative-activity, source-age, decay-data, and competitor-workflow validation remain open.

entries.title: Operational calculator parity
entries.notes: Executable calculator and optimization paths are not evidence of validated dose, shielding, detection-limit, or irradiation-optimization parity.

entries.title: Archive, batch, k0, and experimental-bundle workflows
entries.notes: File query, batch, and ffexp paths exist; archive depth, governed k0 parity, and complete report/bundle evidence remain open.

entries.title: Repo-backed parity fixtures and manifests
entries.notes: Manifests and initial cases exist; the complete licensed, source-linked parity corpus does not.

entries.title: Algorithm-level parity tests
entries.notes: Initial parser, background, and peak-fit cases do not close all advertised algorithm families.

entries.title: Workflow-level parity tests
entries.notes: Initial executable workflow cases exist; same-input end-to-end competitor and UWNR golden suites remain open.

entries.title: Direct-manipulation spectrum canvas
entries.notes: Shift-drag ROI creation, signal and sideband handles, exact peak selection and centroid dragging, context actions, spectrum roles, table/plot synchronization, focused undo/redo, viewport persistence, and stale-analysis invalidation are implemented. Real Qt mouse tests pass on Windows and Linux/X11; final release-level Wayland, scaling, and accessibility coverage remains tracked by 3.27.

entries.title: Modern Qt parity workspaces
entries.notes: WorkspaceDocument v2, v1 migration, atomic sessions, and Save/Open replacement are implemented with Windows/Linux tests. Scientific workspace parity for detection limits, shielding, libraries, k0, and optimization remains open, so this stays prototype.

entries.title: GUI polish, dark mode, and saved themes
entries.notes: Implemented, with final cross-platform scaling, accessibility, and full production-copy release gates still open.

entries.title: GUI verification and release acceptance
entries.notes: The acceptance mechanism exists; full parity cannot be marked validated until all ledger entries and native-platform gates close.

entries.title: Irradiation schedule, inventory state, and time-evolution contracts
entries.notes: Inventory timelines exist, but the versioned physical campaign and covariance contract remains open.

entries.title: EOI back-calculation and irradiation activity export
entries.notes: Basic decay back-calculation is executable; full chain-aware uncertainty and provenance validation remains open.

entries.title: Inventory and time-evolution workspace
entries.notes: The workspace displays timeline products but is not a validated arbitrary-segment campaign solver.

entries.title: Bateman and half-life plots with uncertainty
entries.notes: Decay curves exist; complete chains, uncertainty bands, linked plot interaction, and report evidence remain open.

entries.title: Dominant-contributor and FISPACT-style observables
entries.notes: Contributor summaries exist; the complete observable suite and independent reference validation remain open.

entries.title: Nuclide-map and importance-diagram visualizations
entries.notes: Tables and labels must not be claimed as nuclide-map or importance-diagram visualizations.

entries.title: Masking and line-interference ranking
entries.notes: A deterministic review path exists; response-aware uncertainty and reference-case validation remain open.

entries.title: Masking GUI and export
entries.notes: The panel and CSV path exist; linked cooldown/line-choice plots and full native interaction evidence remain open.

entries.title: Comparator and relative NAA mass/concentration inference
entries.notes: Activity review is not a validated comparator mass or concentration inference workflow.

entries.title: Absolute activation inference
entries.notes: Absolute inference requires the shared physical forward model, detector corrections, covariance, and reference cases.

entries.title: Irradiation, cooldown, and count optimization
entries.notes: DI-FOM, FIM, and MWDCS code and unit tests exist, but the shared physical forward model, nuisance marginalization, covariance, exact oracles, and held-out validation remain open.

entries.title: Optimization heatmaps, Pareto plots, and schedule cards
entries.notes: Candidate tables are not heatmaps or Pareto plots; real linked interactive visualizations and exact nondominated sorting remain open.

entries.title: Second-irradiation planner and pulse timeline
entries.notes: A scoring and schedule path exists; posterior transfer, reaction-specific depletion, equal-resource comparison, information gain, and held-out RAFM validation remain open.

entries.title: Shutdown-to-100-year dose endpoints and reports
entries.notes: Endpoint rows are produced; validated dose physics, uncertainty, contributor plots, and complete reports remain open.

entries.title: Benchmark experimental ffexp bundle
entries.notes: Bundle export exists; versioned schemas, migrations, complete plots, checksums, and reproducibility gates remain open.

entries.title: Activation-inventory regression fixtures and plot tests
entries.notes: Initial fixtures and smoke probes exist; scientific golden results and Windows/Linux native plot interaction remain open.

entries.title: USB HID and Ethernet acquisition drivers
entries.notes: Only generic HAL/mock foundations are claimed; vendor drivers require named hardware, SDK review, and hardware-in-loop evidence.

entries.title: Device discovery and device-list surfaces
entries.notes: Discovery must first close against a deterministic simulator, then against each named physical device.

entries.title: Digital Twin telemetry dashboard
entries.notes: Offline predictive panels are not live device telemetry.

entries.title: Live time-energy spectrogram
entries.notes: No live time-energy stream or spectrogram is claimed; a deterministic list-mode simulator is the first acceptance target.

entries.title: Testing-catalog crosswalk closure
entries.notes: The crosswalk mechanism is implemented; complete source-family closure is tracked by 5.2 through 5.6.

entries.title: Spectrum IO and analysis parity closure
entries.notes: Initial cases do not close the full parser, calibration, background, search, fit, and activity source-family matrix.

entries.title: GUI and workflow parity closure
entries.notes: Role and ROI cases exist; full direct manipulation, calculators, archive, multi-spectrum, report, and native-platform parity remain open.

entries.title: Inventory, NAA, and activation parity closure
entries.notes: Initial inventory fixtures exist; uncertainty-bearing k0/INAA and full activation workflow parity remain open.

entries.title: Inverse and covariance parity closure
entries.notes: Multiple unfolding methods exist; measurement/response covariance, STAYSL-style adjustment, UMG integral/sensitivity outputs, and evaluated UWNR validation remain open.

entries.title: Full parity acceptance and release gate
entries.notes: This gate cannot validate until backend, CLI, GUI, fixtures, tests, native Windows/Linux probes, sizing, documentation, and status evidence all close.

entries.title: Energy-calibration residual-first diagnostics
entries.notes: Measured-minus-fit residuals exist; final cross-platform visual-golden and report integration remain open.

entries.title: Efficiency curves, residuals, review band, and detector persistence
entries.notes: Registered models exist; percentage residuals, the review band, covariance, full detector-profile persistence, and golden calibration cases remain open.

entries.title: Off, Compact, and Full peak-residual modes
entries.notes: Mini residual rendering exists; complete modes, linked ranges, per-channel severity, and persisted mode defaults remain open.

entries.title: Direct ROI, sideband, and peak manipulation with undo
entries.notes: Canonical ROI signal/sideband and peak-centroid edits are emitted as renderer-independent intents, committed once per completed drag, persisted in WorkspaceDocument v2, and covered by exact undo/redo and native Windows/Linux mouse tests.

entries.title: Context actions, assignments, pins, tags, overlap edits, and spectrum roles
entries.notes: The spectrum context menu exposes stable-ID add/select/move/delete, assignment, pin, tag, component add/split/merge, ROI, viewport, crosshair, export, and foreground/background/secondary role actions with persistence and focused undo coverage.

entries.title: Graph-table synchronization and plot-driven edits
entries.notes: Exact spectrum, ROI, and peak IDs drive bidirectional table/plot selection, including duplicate-energy peaks; table selection zooms to the canonical ROI, plot edits refresh tables and clear stale derived results, and save/reload preserves the edits.

entries.title: Canvas navigation, crosshair, export, and keyboard access
entries.notes: The primary spectrum canvas now has zoom, pan, reset, crosshair/readout, persisted viewport state, and an export action with native Windows/Linux interaction evidence. This carryover remains prototype until the same navigation and keyboard contract is applied to every scientific plot.

entries.title: Self-contained analytical reports with plot diagnostics
entries.notes: HTML/PDF infrastructure exists; mandatory spectrum, calibration, efficiency, residual, unfolding, QA, provenance, and optimization graphics remain open.
